summary: Implementation plan for the Next-Gen Smart UV Unwrap Suite, including non-repetitive stochastic angle-relaxed tight mapping with island bleeding, multi-UV channel management, UV texture rebaker with export midfix naming, 3D viewport X-Ray vertex brush selector for Symmetrize UV, and a 2D UV Map N-Panel with UV sculpting brushes. Follows multi-language parity starting with Rust core/web, migrating to Python Desktop and Native C.
